agyos_skill.intent: Automated AI research paper drafting and publication-ready LaTeX manuscript generation using Google Cloud AI Research's PaperOrchestra multi-agent architecture and PaperWritingBench methodology.
agyos_skill.instructions: Based on Google Cloud AI Research's PaperOrchestra framework (`google-research/paper-orchestra`), this skill decouples research execution from academic writing. It transforms unstructured, raw pre-writing materials—sparse idea notes, experimental logs, raw metric outputs, and code repositories—into submission-ready LaTeX manuscripts formatted to conference specifications (e.g., CVPR, ICLR, NeurIPS). Prior autonomous research systems tightly couple experiment execution with manuscript drafting. PaperOrchestra isolates the manuscript authoring process: - Takes human-provided or agent-generated raw materials as read-only inputs. - Parses numerical metrics directly from execution logs to prevent metric hallucination in tables. - Applies a cooperative sequential multi-agent pipeline of specialized roles. All text, data points, and citations in the generated manuscript must belong to one of three verified classes: 1. `EXPERIMENTAL EVIDENCE`: Directly parsed from execution logs, benchmark evaluation files, or table artifacts. 2. `GROUNDED CITATION`: Retrieved from verified APIs (arXiv, Semantic Scholar, CrossRef, PubMed) with confirmed DOIs or arXiv identifiers. 3. `METHODOLOGICAL PROSE`: Technical explanations grounded strictly in the declared problem formulation, algorithms, and architectures. ``` [Raw Pre-Writing Materials] │ ▼ 1. Outline Agent ─────────────► JSON Section Map + Conference Format (CVPR/ICLR) │ ▼ 2. Visual Asset Agent ────────► Matplotlib/Seaborn Plots + Architecture Diagrams │ ▼ 3. Literature Review Agent ───► API-Grounded Citation Retrieval (>=90% retention) │ ▼ 4. Section Writing Agent ─────► Full LaTeX Draft (Direct log metrics in tables) │ ▼
